prior: Uniform physical box, internal depth<Moho depth; author empirical Vp/rho/Q relationships; known two finite constant layers; no posterior truncation to selected modes
candidates: 2048 learned K2 draws plus8192 raw prior draws; pure-prior replaces each valid learned proposal by one valid prior proposal; same valid candidate scoring counts.32 MAP optimizations per arm:16 learned+16 prior vs global32 prior.300 iteration cap each.
candidate_role: Genuine three-band/three-bin training RF only. Flow candidates are physical forward-scored; no network density or discriminator modifies target. Effective field sigma metadata and noise distribution may be outside training support.
generalization_policy: One identical frozen million-structure synthetic-trained Transformer flow and checkpoint hash across all regions/stations. No region-specific training, fine tuning, labels, weights, hyperparameters or candidate-allocation policy. Observation-derived ray/noise context is inference input only. Regional held-out fits never update the model.

hmc.velocity_MWG: fixed symmetric block proposal and exact MH test

original.schedule: Unchanged shipped DRAM settings; random-machine-time seeds under TZ=Asia/Shanghai

data: Genuine RFs recalculated from public raw three-component SAC, common target middle-bin gaussian2.5; joint target three bins/three bands with training covariance
assessment: Balanced256 posterior draws/arm; all failures retained. Frozen4000/1500 prefixes2000,2500,3000,4000 diagnose sample budgets without new stopping decisions. Held-out RF predicts new events, not geological truth.
comparison_limits: Original/common and joint targets reported separately. Sample budgets differ across kernels. Flow/candidate optimization and HMC sampling use remote GPU; the unmodified author program uses serial remote CPU processes. CPU portability checked separately. Timings recorded per stage; no hardware-independent speed factor or CUDA acceleration story.
